title: Book Ecosystem Chart Rules
description: Single source of truth for chart-pair compatibility, recommended chart types, filters, grouping, and notes for the Book Ecosystem dataset. Rewritten to a strict, non-prose schema (chartTypes/conditionalChartTypes/excludedChartTypes as exact enums, aggregation as a closed set, cumulative and derivedMetric as first-class capabilities). Assessment Point permanently disabled as an axis. 21 auto-generated categorical pairings disabled pending manual review. Extended with Reading Nation program coverage (cost-per-participant, net financial position, program duration). v2.1.0: fixed a systemic gap where single-community aggregation (groupBy=communityName) was missing from measure comparisons that already supported bookEcosystem/region grouping -- this specifically re-enables single-community-vs-national/state-benchmark charts for kindergarten readiness, grade 4 reading, grade 8 reading, literacy, and HS graduation rate. Also enabled pie/doughnut as conditional chart types for single-dimension x single-measure comparisons (communityName, bookEcosystem, or region vs any numeric measure) so any field can be charted on its own, unaggregated-comparison-wise, per category. Added 7 previously-missing comparison keys (collectionQuality x bookEcosystem/region, the four assessment-point subscores x communityName, and overheadExpenseAmount x communityName) so every numeric field now has a working pairing with all three aggregation dimensions.
